candidate_relations.reason: Goodpasture syndrome is a related pulmonary-renal syndrome but asserts anti-GBM disease rather than ANCA-associated vasculitis.
SARS-CoV-2-negative multifocal/cavitary consolidations were interpreted as pneumonia, a pulmonary manifestation rather than AAV.
EGPA is an ANCA-associated subtype that requires an eosinophilic/asthmatic phenotype not described here, so it is an incompatible AAV subtype.
There is no rheumatoid arthritis history or ILD pattern establishing RA-associated lung disease.
None does not identify ANCA-associated vasculitis.

case_quality_flags: Table 2 infectious/serologic results are not included; ANCA versus anti-GBM cannot be read from the narrative alone.
